prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: brand mascot and logo direction validation

Create a cute premium 3D brand mascot system for ClawX / Verse Claw, inspired by modern Chinese brand IP presentation: soft vinyl toy, rounded clay-like 3D character, minimal facial features, clean dark/orange brand card composition, warm playful product mascot design.

Character concept: "Clawling", a small yellow AI companion with a round chubby body. It wears a red-orange soft hood shaped like three rounded claw/flame petals. The hood must clearly suggest the ClawX claw identity while staying cute, soft, and simple. It must not look like a mushroom cap. The mascot has a golden yellow body, cream-white belly patch shaped like a small claw print, tiny black oval eyes, small rounded side arms, and short red-orange feet.

Logo relationship: include a small simplified logo mark near the mascot only if it fits naturally: yellow face silhouette + red claw hood + cream claw mark. The logo mark should be icon-like, not text.

Style and materials: soft matte vinyl, smooth clay render, gentle studio lighting, rounded bevels, toy-like but premium, low-detail high-recognition brand mascot. No hard mechanical parts, no metallic armor, no sharp blade claws.

Composition: centered mascot on a clean warm orange rounded card or simple brand presentation background, with generous padding. The image should feel like a polished brand mascot/action-extension presentation board, but without readable text.

Color palette: dominant warm yellow, red-orange hood, cream white accents, black eyes, very subtle shadow.

Avoid: mecha, robot helmet, metal, sharp armor, crab, lobster, realistic animal, horror, complex textures, busy background, text, letters, watermark, existing brand logos.
